description: This file contains unit tests for the DynamoDB implementation of the Orleans reminders table, including setup, initialization, and various test cases for reminders operations.

classes.name: DynamoDBRemindersTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for DynamoDB reminders table in Orleans, testing initialization, reminders range, parallel upsert, and simple reminder retrieval.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of DynamoDBReminderTable if DynamoDB is available; otherwise, skips the test.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Returns the connection string for DynamoDB service if available.

methods.name: RemindersTable_AWS_Init
methods.description: Test for initializing the DynamoDB reminders table.

methods.name: RemindersTable_AWS_RemindersRange
methods.description: Test for retrieving a range of reminders.

methods.name: RemindersTable_AWS_RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: Test for parallel upsert of reminders.
